Definition: genitive case of G5210; of (from or concerning) you:--ye, you, your (own, -selves).
BiblicalUsage: hymōn means of you, your, yours. In Matthew 5:11, the text says "when [men] shall revile you."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, hymōn, does its job quietly — of you, your, yours — and I leave it at that.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
